subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC3 not met: `live_preview` is destructured from config in `setCommonConfig` but immediately discarded with `void live_preview;`. The acceptance criterion explicitly requires that preview context (live_preview/preview_hash) can 'flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig'. The interface field was added (AC3) but the value never reaches the query object — it is silently dropped. This is the exact defect called out in prior review feedback: 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'. The comment explaining SDK 3.17.2 limitations does not satisfy the AC; if the SDK supports `query.addParam('live_preview', preview_hash)` or similar, that should be used. If not, the AC cannot be met by this approach alone.
issues.suggestedFix: Forward the preview_hash to the query object. For Contentstack SDK 3.x, this is typically done via `query.addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash)` or by passing it as part of the query configuration. Replace `void live_preview;` with: `if (live_preview?.preview_hash) { (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash); }` — or whichever SDK method the installed version exposes. Add a unit test verifying the query receives the preview_hash.

issues.description: `export const options: any = {` introduces an explicit `any` type annotation without an explanatory comment, violating TypeScript strict compliance rules. The original code used implicit typing (`export const options = {`). The change to `any` was made to accommodate the conditional spread of `live_preview`, but a proper interface or `Record<string, unknown>` with a comment would be preferable.
issues.suggestedFix: Define a typed interface for the Stack options (e.g., `IContentstackStackOptions`) or revert to implicit typing (which was already correctly inferred). If `any` is truly needed for SDK compatibility, add an inline comment: `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Contentstack SDK options type is incomplete`.

issues.description: The test 'should not set live_preview when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is missing' sets `process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN = undefined`. While this works in Node.js (setting to undefined deletes the property), using `delete process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` is more explicit and robust across environments.

The `live_preview` field on `ICommonContentstackConfig` defines `enable?: boolean` and `preview_hash?: string`, but these fields are never populated by any caller in the codebase. A grep across `src/` for `live_preview`, `livePreview`, `preview_hash`, and `previewHash` in non-test files returns zero matches outside of `contentstack.ts` and `contentstack.spec.ts`. No `getStaticProps`, page component, or service call passes preview context through `ICommonContentstackConfig`. Without callers populating this field, the interface addition is dead code.
issues.suggestedFix: Either add a follow-up ticket to wire preview context from Next.js preview mode through to Contentstack service calls (e.g., threading `context.preview` from `getStaticProps` into `getEntry`/`getSingleEntry` calls), or document in the PR description that caller-side wiring is intentionally deferred.
